args.rationale: Successor exposure attaches to Halcyon for the ACQUISITION 1 Pellworth Canning consumer class claim under the express agreement exception. Section 7.2 of the executed asset purchase agreement expressly states that the purchaser "assumes all product liability obligations of Seller, whether arising before or after Closing." The consumer class claim over defective seams in cans Pellworth manufactured before closing is squarely a product liability obligation of the seller, and the assumption clause thereby covers the relevant class of liabilities. Under the firm rule memo, an assumption clause covering the relevant class of liabilities is sufficient by itself to trigger the express agreement exception (exception (1)), so successor liability attaches to the purchaser.
